caseNameFull: Stacey JOHNSON v. Wendy KELLEY, Director, Arkansas Department of Correction

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Arkansas denied. Justice SOTOMAYOR, with whom Justice BREYER joins, dissenting from the denial of certiorari: I dissent from the denial of certiorari for the reasons set out in Arthur v. Dunn, 580 U.S. ----, 137 S.Ct. 725, --- L.Ed.2d ---- (2017) (SOTOMAYOR, J., dissenting from denial of certiorari).
